name: Stencil-based Clipping Geometries
definition: A method to clip volumetric data using arbitrary closed surface geometries (represented by triangles) by locking pixels in the stencil buffer where the volume intersects the clipping object's cross-section with slicing planes.
summary: Stencil-based clipping uses the OpenGL stencil buffer to restrict volume rendering to pixels inside or outside an arbitrary closed surface, decoupling the clipping boundary from the volume data.
